# Chromebook Unlocked Games

> Chromebook Unlocked Games (chromebookunlocked.github.io) is a free website with 186 browser games. Each game has its own page and runs in a browser tab, so it can be played on a Chromebook, Windows PC or Mac without downloading or installing anything.

## Facts

- Number of games: 186
- Price: free, no account needed
- Platform: web browser (HTML5); no download or install
- Game page address pattern: https://chromebookunlocked.github.io/<Game Name>.html
- Largest categories: Action, Arcade, Mobile, Casual, Puzzle and Adventure
- Whether the site loads on a school network depends on that network's filter.

## Main pages

- [All unblocked games](https://chromebookunlocked.github.io/): homepage with search and the full game list
- [Contact](https://chromebookunlocked.github.io/important-pages/contact.html)
- [DMCA and copyright](https://chromebookunlocked.github.io/important-pages/dmca.html)
- [Privacy policy](https://chromebookunlocked.github.io/important-pages/privacy-policy.html)
